name: Anvilcloud Drake
senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 14

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The drake makes two Fang attacks.

Actions.name: Fang
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage. If the drake moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit and the target is Large or smaller, the target has the Prone condition, and the drake can make one Fang attack against it as a Bonus Action.

Actions.name: Thunder Burst (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 42 (12d6) Thunder damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Traits.name: Thunder Retort
Traits.text: A creature that hits the drake with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) Thunder damage and has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn.

lore: Hatched in the anvil-clouds of a perpetual thunderhead, it rides the leading edge of the squall line and treats every rolling peal as both its first breath and its hunting cry.

generation.userConcept: a young storm drake whose breath is a rolling wall of thunder
